verdict.rationale: ROS 2 is API-first. Client libraries in multiple languages expose the core functionality: topics, services, actions, parameters, lifecycle and bag reading/writing. The `ros2` CLI covers introspection and operation of nodes, topics, services, bags and security. The bare-bones install ships communication libraries and CLI tools with no GUI at all, so the GUI tools (RViz, rqt) sit on top of the same programmatic interfaces rather than holding exclusive capabilities. missing for 10: an explicit documented statement of API/GUI parity, evidence that RViz/rqt visualization functions are reachable programmatically, parity across client libraries (lifecycle, composition and content filtering are C++-only), and independent hands-on corroboration.
